LanguageData.DBHW_Inactive: Patch inactive. Check Player.log for [DBH Body Size Waste] errors.
LanguageData.DBHW_Formula: Output = original output × multiplier × BodySize^influence Influence 0: ignore size / 1: proportional / 2: squared
LanguageData.DBHW_Ground: Also scale bodily feces/urine filth on the ground
LanguageData.DBHW_Notes: Applies to toilets, latrines and outdoor defecation. Uses actual BodySize including growth, race and gene modifiers. Water consumption and bathroom frequency are unchanged. Bedpans are excluded. Fractional filth uses stochastic rounding, capped at 100 units per attempt. Changes apply to the next production event.
LanguageData.DBHW_StatFormula: Multiplier = BodySize^{1} × {0} Regular / latrine: 14 × Flush size × multiplier Advanced: 7 × Flush size × multiplier Outdoors: 10 × multiplier
LanguageData.DBHW_StatDisabled: Size scaling is disabled or inactive; original production is shown.
LanguageData.DBHW_StatLimits: Expected production per use, not per day. Excludes bedpans and spacer toilets. Remaining latrine capacity, sewage disposal and Lite mode may change actual accumulation. Outdoor sewage is separate from filth object count. Reopen the info card after changing settings to refresh the displayed values.
